name: Enter Roundtable
_source: s;Fuuko;I still haven't met everyone yet.
s;Andy;Always fill up the Roundtable seat before you enter the Roundtable room.
s;Nico;Right on time.{w} Andy, Fuuko, here's the Apocalypse book you asked for...{c:wait;400}{br}Wha-
s;Apoccy;Pwahaaah! Finally, I've been tired of waiting!
s;Apoccy;Hmm? Looks who we have here.{c:wait;400} You think you can do a better job than Unjustice?
s;Fuuko;Enough wisecracks.{c:wait;400} Let's just start, Apocalypse.
s;Apoccy;Hah! Putting on a front, are we?|Fine, take your seats first!

name: Intro
_source: choice;choice_tutorial;<yellow>Neutralize UMA Tutorial?</>;True|Not yet. I've never played Fire Emblem, False|Sure. I already know basic Fire Emblem;;vert;bottom
s;;The world began with only man and earth.;0,0;240;clear;;;text
s;;Then, <red>Rules</> were added, along with the <red>UMAs</> that manifested them:;0,0;240;clear;;;text;no_block;hold
s;;<yellow>{rule}</>;{e:100 + (1 if game.get_random(0, 1) else -1) * game.get_random(24,100)},{e: 92 + (1 if game.get_random(0, 1) else -1) * game.get_random(24,44)};;clear;;;text;no_block;hold

s;;Make no mistake, there isn't a single rule designed to aid men's survival.|And yet, mankind's hope only grew stronger.|Combating the UMAs is <yellow>the Union</>,{c:sound;FireBall}{c:add_region;vision_apoccy;{v:pos_apoccy};1,1;vision;4}|an organisation specialized in hunting <yellow>UMAs</>, completing <yellow>Quests</>, and recruiting new <yellow>Negators</>.|At the center of the Union lies the <yellow>Roundtable</>, where only their main members can take seats.|{c:mf}And, no matter what,{c:wait;800} only <yellow>the Leader</> can take the first seat.;0,0;240;clear;;;text
s;Fuuko;Everyone...please...{c:wait;800}please wait for me.|I will save you all. I promise.
s;Andy;Haha, look who turned into a big crybaby.
s;Fuuko;I can't help it.|I watched everyone march to their death to protect me.;low_priority
s;Andy;Yeesh! Never mind that.|Don't tell me, you already forget why they risked their lives?|Forget the dream they entrusted you with?

s;Fuuko;...I want to see Tatiana wearing the dresses she loves.|And I want to see Top running as fast as he can.|And for Chikara to be able to attend school without shaking in fear.|A place where everyone can hold hands and live how they want.;low_priority
s;Fuuko;That's the sort of world I want to live in...{c:wait;800}with everyone!
s;Andy;That's the spirit!{w} Listen up!|For the past decade, Nico and I have already built the base and prepared the resources.|We can start the Quest as soon as right now.
s;Fuuko;Was that Mr. Nico? Let's hurry!
s;;Don't jinx me! I'm still safe, but not for long.|The monsters are targeting this book. So please, save me quick!;top
s;Andy;You just got back, so rest up, Fuuko. I will handle-
s;Fuuko;No need for discussion, we fight together!

name: Fuuko Death
_source: s;Fuuko;No... It's not...|{c:e;Fuuko;CloseEyes}I'm sorry, Andy...|Everyone...forgive me...

name: Tutorial 2
_source: s;;Great! Now move <blue>Fuuko</> to attack the other enemy as well.|As Fuuko's weapon is a firearm, place her <yellow>1 space away from the target</> to attack.;;;Tutorial

name: Tutorial 1
_source: s;;Howdy, player!|Thanks for sparing me earlier.|Whether we have met before, let me introduce myself regardless:|The name's <blue>Tutorial.{br}UMA Tutorial!</>|And I'm here to make sure the journey will be as smooth as possible for the player.;;;Tutorial

s;;First tip: During cutscene, be careful not to press <blue>{e:engine.get_key_name(cf.SETTINGS['key_BACK']).upper()}</> or <blue>{e:engine.get_key_name(cf.SETTINGS['key_START']).upper()}</>, as you will then skip everything. Unless that's what you want.{br};;;Tutorial

s;;...Hm?{c:wait;800} That message was too fast for you to read?|Maybe press <blue>{e:engine.get_key_name(cf.SETTINGS['key_INFO']).upper()}</> and you will be able to re-read past dialogues.|Now, let's move on to the actual gameplay.;;;Tutorial
s;;See that green unit? The objective this chapter is to <yellow>keep him safe</>.|If either him or Fuuko die, it will be <red>game over</>.|To protect him, attack the red units.;;;Tutorial

s;;There is an enemy in front of Andy.|Press <blue>{e:engine.get_key_name(cf.SETTINGS['key_SELECT']).upper()}</> on Andy to select him, then <yellow>move Andy right next to the enemy</> and start attacking.;;;Tutorial

name: Tutorial 3
condition: v('choice_tutorial') and 'Fuuko' in (unit.nid, unit2.nid) and u('Fuuko').get_hp() < u('Fuuko').get_max_hp()
_source: s;;Not like it's a big deal, but <blue>Fuuko</> isn't at her full health right now.|Heal Fuuko up by <yellow>clicking on Item</> when selecting her, then <yellow>choose Panpanda</> to use.;;;Tutorial

name: Tutorial 4
_source: s;;See those <blue>forest tiles</>? Units will <yellow>gain bonus defense and avoid chance</> while standing on it.|More details can be seen by <yellow>hovering the cursor over said tiles</>.|However, such tiles often hinder units' movements, making units move less far than usual.|Even so, do try to place your units there if possible, to gain the slight advantage in combat.;;;Tutorial

name: Enemy Clear
_source: s;Nico;Andy! That was cutting close, you know.{w} But thank you.
s;Andy;Never mind it. I see that you've managed to find the book as well.
s;Fuuko;I see, you had Apocalypse with you, that's what attracts the UMAs.
s;Nico;Ah, lil Miss. I saw your fighting out there. Thank you for saving me.|I guess, just like Andy, you must be a Negator, too.{w} Miss...?
s;Fuuko;Fuuko.{c:wait;400} It's Fuuko.|It's nice to meet you again, Mr. Nico.
s;Nico;Hm? I must have forgotten that we met before.
s;Fuuko;...No,{c:wait;400} this is the first time I meet this you.
s;Nico;Argh! Great.{c:wait;400} Another one who talks in riddles. Are all Negators like this?|Ah, right! Important question first. You mentioned the UMAs. What are they exactly?
s;Andy;Unidentified Mysterious Animals.{c:wait;400} They are hostile, wicked creatures that hold reality-bending power.|The monsters chasing you just now are Juniors, offshoots of an UMA.
s;Nico;Monsters...Reality-bending...{c:bop;Nico;no_block}Such unscientific nonsenses!|If this is a cruel joke from God, I sure want to punch him right now.
s;Fuuko;Heh.{c:wait;400} I'm glad you are still the you that I knew, Mr. Nico.
s;Nico;Again with the riddles...{c:wait;400}And then there is the matter with this book.
s;Fuuko;That's the Book of Apocalypse. It is important for doing Quests.|Which is exactly what I want your help with, Mr. Nico.
s;Nico;Slow down, lil Miss.{c:wait;400} Our organisation already has our hands full.|And we just met you, how can you expect us to trust you right away?|Right, Andy?
s;Andy;Ah, I didn't have the chance to tell you properly earlier.|But as of right now, Fuuko is the leader of the Union.
s;Andy;But Nico made a good point. Know our base first would be better.
s;Fuuko;Okay, I'm excited to meet everyone as well!{c:wait;400} Let's head back.
s;Nico;Can you two wait just a sec...

s;;...{w}Sorry to interrupt your game, player.{c:wait;400} But the fighting was almost too easy, right??|Can hardly be called a level, even. I didn't even get to teach you half of mechanic!|Something must be missing...Something...{c:wait;800}such as a <red>Boss fight!!</>;0,0;240;;;;text;bg_black;;;;0.2
s;Andy;That's an UMA. I don't think I have seen this one before.
s;Nico;!!{c:wait;400} We encountered one right away? Right here in our base?|Isn't this situation...{c:wait;400} really, really bad?
s;Fuuko;The Juniors just now...{c:wait;400} they are its subordinates.
s;Andy;Tsk! Our intel is limited.{w} Move with caution, Fuuko.

s;;Hehehe...Sorry dear player, but being an UMA, I have been your enemy from the start.|As the embodiment of Tutorial myself, there is no one better to serve as the boss of this Prologue.|So here is another tutorial for you, player:|<red>Defeat the boss!</>;0,0;240;;;;text;bg_black;;;;0.2

name: Tutorial 5
_source: s;;Wow, slow down a bit. <blue>Fuuko</>'s death will lead to game over, remember?|My attacks can end her in one strike, so do make sure to <yellow>move her out of danger</>.|You can press <blue>{e:engine.get_key_name(cf.SETTINGS['key_INFO']).upper()}</> to clearly see the danger zone.;;;Tutorial

name: Tutorial 6
_source: s;;Did you see that? <blue>Andy</> just negated his own death!{w} That's cus he's the <purple>Undead Negator</>.|Whenever he receives a lethal attack, he survives and <yellow>cannot move for 2 turns</> instead.|You can press <blue>{e:engine.get_key_name(cf.SETTINGS['key_INFO']).upper()}</> on Andy to learn more about him and his combat arsenal.|That's such a cheat ability, to be honest, so how about I spike the difficulty up a bit?;;;Tutorial

name: Tutorial 7
_source: s;Andy;None of our attacks works on the UMA...
s;Fuuko;Andy! Let's do it!{c:wait;800} Our combo attack!
s;;This is great! Just like Andy, Fuuko is also a <purple>Negator</>,{w} and I now get to teach you how to use her ability!|First, let Fuuko <yellow>use Unluck on Andy</>.;;;Tutorial

name: Tutorial 8
_source: s;;Now that Andy is cursed with <red>Unluck</>, he is basically a time bomb!|Position him so that Fuuko doesn't get caught in <yellow>explosion range</>, while the enemies do.;;;Tutorial

name: Tutorial Damaged
_source: s;;Urgh...{c:wait;800}Ha...{c:wait;400}Hahaha!|You really did it! You managed to take a chunk of my health.|I will retreat for now, as there are still many more tutorials to be taught.|Till we meet again.;0,0;240;;;;text;bg_black;;;;0.2
s;Nico;W-what was that? Was that a meteor??
s;Fuuko;Yea, that was my negation. I negate luck of whom I touch.
s;Nico;!! That's awful!{c:wait;400} Ain't that gonna work against us more than not?
s;Andy;Nico, negations aren't superpowers.{c:wait;400} They are curses. Unwanted curses.
s;Nico;I...I understand.{c:wait;400} Sorry, lil Miss. You must have been through a lot.
s;Fuuko;It's okay. Turning this curse back towards our enemies, that's how negators fight.
s;Andy;Speaking of enemies, that UMA fled fast.
s;Nico;W-wha,{c:wait;400} it's still alive after that meteor attack? Should we chase after it now?
s;Fuuko;No, I say we let it be. I have a feeling that it won't attack anyone after this.
s;Nico;!! That's just gut feeling! It's unscientific!
s;Andy;Sick!{c:wait;400} Wicked Sick!|Our leader already made her decision, Nico.

name: Base Talks
_source: s;Andy;Well, the layout hasn't changed at all, but let me show you again all the same.|This is the bottom floor of our base. The elevator is over there.
s;Andy;Use them to meet everyone else.|The Roundtable is behind that giant door.|Before you enter, don't forget to fill up Roundtable seats.
s;Nico;Ah, lil Miss, welcome to the Laboratory.|Non-physical weapons and miscellaneous items are produced on demand here.|Impressive right?
s;Fuuko;You guys got so much stuffs done already. It feels magical in here.
s;Nico;Nonsense! It's all science!|By the way, my team is extra busy right now, so I can only join you later.|If you have any confusion, check our Archive on your left.
s;Fuuko;I'm Fuuko. Glad to know that you're still our weaponsmith.|I will come to you whenever I need more physical weapons.
s;Fuuko;Ah, no thanks, right now I just want to say hello.|I shall take my leave now.

name: Roundtable Talks
_source: s;Nico;Quest? Rewards? Penalty?...{c:wait;400} Huh?|Lil Miss, you have so much explanations to do!

name: Intro
_source: s;Juiz;Now that you've sat in this seat,{c:wait;400} you are this organisation's new boss.{c:e;Fuuko;HalfCloseEyes}{c:wait;100}{c:e;Fuuko;OpenEyes}|The new UNION is now in your hands,{c:wait;400} Fuu-{c:move_portrait;Fuuko;CenterRight;2;no_block}{c:screen_shake;400;celeste;no_block}{c:bop;Juiz;1;no_block}{c:e;Fuuko;CloseEyes}

s;Fuuko;Ms. Juiz...{c:wait;800} I'm afraid I can't reassure you.{c:wait;800} I'm far too weak.|{c:e;Fuuko;HalfCloseEyes}But...{c:wait;800}{c:e;Fuuko;HalfCloseEyes} Mr. Victor told me once before,{c:wait;400} that I was just like you, Ms. Juiz.|That I was willing to bet it all for them.{c:wait;800} That spirit-{c:wait;400}that <blue>Soul</>-That was what I had!|So I-{c:wait;400}I know that much is certainly true.|It's thanks to the UNION that I got to be this way, after all.
s;Juiz;No...{c:wait;400} It's your hard work that moves other people's hearts to help you.|So thank you, Fuuko.
s;Andy;Juiz!{c:wait;400} Those tremors just keep getting bigger.

s;Juiz;Fuuko.{c:wait;400} Our job begins from this point on.{c:wait;800} Please have faith and wait here.|Now that I'm no longer the leader, I can finally fight. I'll be off now...{c:wait;400} boss!|I will risk my life along with the others to ensure that you go through the loop.
s;Fuuko;Ah...{c:wait;400} everyone...{c:wait;400} risking their lives again...

s;Andy;Don't tell me this late in the game, you're blaming yourselves for everyone dying or whatever!|Listen, all we do right now is grab hold of the baton that everyone has passed to us...|So that the two of us can go through the loop, get stronger and come out on top!|Ain't that right?
s;Andy;You got it, chief.{c:wait;400} Catch ya on the flip side, Fuuko!

s;Juiz;Yes. That is God.{c:wait;400} <bconvo><red>Sun</></>{w}{clear}Listen up, UNION!{c:wait;400} This is my last order to you as former boss!|This is Ragnarok-The very end of the world.{c:wait;400} So don't hesitate to risk your lives.|For these last few minutes,{c:wait;400} give it our all to stop God from reaching Fuuko!|Operation...{c:wait;400} STARTS!

name: Union Reinforcement
_source: s;Mui;Master Shen,{c:wait;400} a-are we all that's left?
s;Shen;My dear Mui,{c:wait;400} I'm afraid we don't have much time either.|Let us not worry about death and ensure Fuuko make it to the next loop!
s;Mui;Even then, I remain hopeful...{c:wait;800} that the seven of us survive,{c:wait;400} just for these last few minutes.

name: Outro
_source: if;all(game.check_alive(unit_nid) for unit_nid in game.level.unit_groups.get('Union').units) and game.check_alive('Juiz_100')
s;Mui;Ms. Fuuko, a gift to the next loop!
s;Fuuko;All of you,{c:wait;400} thank you.|{c:bop;Fuuko;no_block}Now it's time to go!

name: Unit Death
_source: s;{unit};Y-you dare killing an UMA?!{c:wait;400} The very embodiment of a Rule?!|You shall suffer the consequence of that r-right now!
s;{unit};Takesss away Melody,{c:wait;400} and thisss world will forever sssink in sssilence.
s;{unit};Victor, it's amazing isn't it?{c:wait;400} We pulled together...{c:wait;400}{c:e;{unit};CloseEyes,Smile} some amazing allies.
s;Mui;Sheeen!{c:wait;400} Shen!{c:wait;400} Oh, Master Shen!{c:wait;400} It's gonna be okay now. I'm here.{c:wait;400}{c:move_portrait;Mui;120,80} I'm right here...

s;Shen;Mui...{c:wait;400}{c:e;Shen;HalfCloseEyes} Mui, my dear.|Life before you came...{c:wait;400} was a mindless, murderous world.{c:wait;400} You brought me peace, kindness, and love.| I have been in love you, and will always be until the day I die.

s;{unit};Were my efforts...{c:wait;400} going to help changing fates?|No...{c:wait;400} it wasn't just me. You two were there...{c:wait;400} every step of the way...|{c:e;{unit};CloseEyes}Goodnight...{c:wait;400} Leila...{c:wait;400} Latla...

name: Final Push
_source: s;Andy;Everyone!{c:wait;400} Fuuko!{c:wait;400} This is the final push!{c:wait;400} Hold on just a little longer now!

s;Juiz;With bitter regrets of my late comrades.|With my own powerlessness.|With the rage of the torment you caused us these last 455.4 billion undying years.|{c:e;Juiz;OpenEyes}I'll imbue all of my rage in this last attack against you,{c:bop;Juiz;no_block} God!
s;Shen;Mui, my dear.{c:wait;400} You helped me realised that the world is full of love and kindness.|Please, let me protect you a little while longer.
s;Mui;Master Shen.{c:wait;400} Even in the next loop,{c:wait;400} I-I will continue to love you until my dying day.
s;Shen;Let's show them what Shin Hakkyouku is made of together!
s;Shen;Mui, all I did was looking back at the warm memories you had given me.|{c:e;Shen;OpenEyes}But, I'm positive,{c:wait;400} as it's stands, I'm the strongest I've ever been.
s;Mui;Master Shen.{c:wait;400} You have given me both mighty words and power that are mine to use.|I shall live up to the call,{c:wait;400} all through eyes devoid of lies.

s;Rip;They can be a UMA or God, it doesn't matter.{c:wait;400} I'm going to save everything I hold dear.|If fate decides to take away my happy ending right before my eyes...|then I'd refute and{c:bop;Juiz;no_block} negate that fate!

s;Fuuko;Gods, you may have toyed with us for hundreds of billions of years...|but it seems you still don't know negators.|What gave us strength.{c:wait;400} What pushed us to live.{c:wait;400} What shaped us and held us together...|has always been this feeling that we gain from those we hold dear.|{c:bop;Fuuko;no_block}Do not underestimate us!
